The '''Alderaan Senatorial Delegation''' was a group of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] chosen to represent the planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and the other worlds of the [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector]], in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The delegation consisted of a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and their [[Aide/Legends|aides]]. One of its historical leaders, [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|ran]] for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], but lost to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When the latter [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and assumed the title of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], the Alderaan Senatorial Delegation remained a part of the revamped [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], however, the Alderaanian delegation was disbanded along with the rest of the Senate when the Emperor decided to [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|shut down]] the assembly. During its many [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of existence, the Alderaan Senatorial Delegation exercised considerable authority in the Senate, and its members long advocated the values of pacifism.

==Organization==
[[File:Alderaan_Delegation.png|thumb|left|200px|Bail Antilles and Agrippa Aldrete, wearing the traditional white garb of the Alderaanian delegation]]
The Alderaan Senatorial Delegation occupied a [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and all other worlds located within [[Alderaan sector/Legends|its]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Atlas">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was apartised by [[Sector/Legends|sectorial]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]].</ref> With Alderaan being part of the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]], the founding worlds of the Republic,<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> its sectorial delegation held considerable power in the Senate.<ref name="YJCCG">{{YJCCG|set=Battle of Naboo|cardname=Alderaan Diplomat|link=battleofnaboo/light/large/26alderaandiplomatsenator.html}}</ref> Its members were often part of [[Prince/Legends|princely]] families, sometimes even the reigning [[Blood/Legends|bloodline]] of Alderaan.<ref name="Noble">Senators of Alderaan [[Gaul Panteer]], [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] were all of [[Noble/Legends|noble]] birth.</ref> The delegates often donned white [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]], following a tradition of the Alderaanian ambassadorial milieu.<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> They were known for promoting peace throughout the Republic,<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Liana Merian}}</ref> although there have been historical exceptions to that rule.<ref name="HOLO">{{Holonet|planets|alderaan|Alderaan}}</ref>

On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a bright [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] that hosted as the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]], the Alderaanian delegation resided at [[Cantham House/Legends|Cantham House]]<ref name="TFU" />&mdash;also known as the Alderaanian consulate.<ref name="CoPL" />

==History==
[[File:Young_Leia_Organa_SWInsider145.jpg|thumb|100px|Leia Organa, the last senator of Alderaan before the disbanding of the Senate]]
{{Quote|I don't know what you're talking about. I'm a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Alderaan&hellip;|Leia Organa to Darth Vader|<ref name="ANH" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Alderaan sector was represented by Prince [[Gaul Panteer]], heir to the Alderaanian crown.<ref name="HOLO2">{{HolonetOld|biographies|bouris-ulgo|Bouris Ulgo}}</ref> Under the guidance of Panteern the leaders of Alderaan became a voice for aggressive military action in the Senate for the first time in history. When the a [[Treaty of Coruscant|peace treaty]] was signed a few years later, Panteer seceded from the Senate in protest. He and his mother [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]] were [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] in the aftermath.<ref name="HOLO" />

Millennia later, under the reign of Queen [[Mazicia Organa]], the senator [[Agrippa Aldrete/Legends|Agrippa Aldrete]] was head of the Alderaanian delegation.<ref name="ins">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref> At some point before [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], he was replaced by Prince [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail]] of the [[House of Antilles|House Antilles]],<ref name="cod" /> who made him one of his aides along with a young woman named [[Liana Merian/Legends|Liana Merian]]. During Antilles' tenure, the Alderaanian delegation was part of the [[Core Faction/Legends|Core faction]], one of the two major factions of representatives in the Senate.<ref name="cod" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Antilles retired from politics after losing the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|Chancery election]] against [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], leader of the [[Naboo Senatorial Delegation]].<ref name="dbLIA">{{DB|character|lianamerian|Merian, Liana}}</ref>

Antilles was succeeded by his namesake, Prince [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]],<ref name="dbLIA" /> whose assistants included [[Sheltay Retrac/Legends|Sheltay Retrac]]<ref name="CSWESHEL">{{CSWECite|III|96|Retrac, Sheltay}}</ref> and [[Sateen Vestswe/Legends|Sateen Vestswe]].<ref name="Arch">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2005/11/sithsnap20051107.html|text=''Sith'' Snapshots: Sith Snapshots: Let Me See Your Identification}}</ref> Organa remained in place as a Galactic Republic senator for thirteen years, and he was renewed following the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with the Galactic Senate becoming the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="dbORG">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref> Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the politicians of Alderaanian were amongst the secret founders of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], an organized group of resistance fighters opposed to the tyranny of the Imperial government.<ref name="TFU" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Bail Organa passed the torch to his adopted daughter, the seventeen-year old Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="First Impressions" /> The Princess, however, did not remain in office for long, since the Senate was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|officially disbanded]] by order of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Moreover, Princess Leia had been arrested shortly earlier by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the Emperor's second-in-command, while she was secretly on a rebel mission above [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ANH" /> A falsified report had been sent, proclaiming that the senator had perished with [[Tantive IV/Legends|her starship]] after encountering a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] field it could not avoid.<ref name="ANHn" />
